# Vendored QR encoder

QRCode JavaScript files with unchanged logic (trailing whitespace normalized) copied from the runtime-owned qrcode-terminal 0.12.0 vendor/QRCode directory. Original encoder copyright Kazuhiko Arase (2009), MIT, with Node adaptations distributed in qrcode-terminal under Apache 2.0. Both license notices are preserved. No terminal wrapper or network service is used. The adapter accepts ASCII HTTP(S) enquiry URLs only, uses automatic QR version selection, level M and a four-module quiet zone. jsQR is used only as an independent test decoder.
